slides.title: Half of shoppers doubt Black Friday deals
slides.sub: New research says many shoppers no longer believe the big markdowns. Here's what makes them trust a small business instead.

slides.title: trust Black Friday prices
slides.body: In BCG's new survey of 10,220 shoppers in 10 countries, only about half believe Black Friday prices are really lower than usual.

slides.title: Some deals saved nothing
slides.body: Groundwork Collaborative checked 351 Amazon Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals. About 3 in 10 cost no less than the month before. Amazon disputes it.

slides.title: plan to spend less or skip
slides.body: That same BCG study found 22% of shoppers plan to cut back on year-end sales because they think deals are always available anyway.

slides.title: What shoppers trust instead
slides.body: In that BCG study, a store's reputation and money-back guarantees earned the most trust, followed by verified reviews and honest price comparisons.

slides.title: Picture Small Business Saturday
slides.body: A shopper finds your shop online. Before buying, she checks your site, your reviews and your return policy. That quick look decides the sale.

slides.title: What to do this week
slides.body: Put your return policy, real customer reviews and regular prices where people can see them, on your website and your Instagram.

caption:
Black Friday trust checklist: 4 things small businesses and Black-owned brands should show shoppers before Small Business Saturday.

Black Friday is November 27 and Small Business Saturday is November 28, and a lot of shoppers are walking in skeptical. In Boston Consulting Group's 2026 Black Friday study of 10,220 consumers in 10 countries, only 54% said they trust that Black Friday prices are really lower than usual. A Groundwork Collaborative review of 351 Amazon Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals from 2024 and 2025 found about 3 in 10 cost no less than the month before. Amazon disputes the findings.

BCG found that a store's reputation, money-back guarantees, verified reviews and clear regular versus sale prices build the most trust. Here's how to show those this week:
1. Put your return or refund policy on your website and in your Instagram highlights.
2. Share real customer reviews, with permission, where shoppers can see them.
3. List your regular price next to any sale price.
4. Keep your logo, colors and voice the same everywhere so people recognize you.

Shoppers check these things before they buy, so make them easy to find.
